processing: Original generated PNGs copied unchanged. sRGB base-color sampling, mirrored repeat, physical geometry for tiles and slab joints. Runtime low-amplitude bump uses a linear clone of each image as a single-channel height approximation; not measured or separately AI-generated normal maps. Foliage and ornaments are code geometry, not AI images.
